paragraphs.text: Kogla is a gigantic ape from the plane of Ikoria .

While visiting Skysail , the planeswalker Vivien Reid witnessed an attack by a small flotilla of military airships, trying to rescue a young woman from the clutches of Kogla. However, it was quickly revealed that the girl was the bonder of the gigantic ape, much to the embarrassment of Skysail's soldiers.

During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Kogla, like other Ikorian beasts, grew crystals on its body that repelled glistening oil . Alongside Yidaro , it fought back against the giant monstrosities of the Copper Host. Kogla used Yidaro's crystal-covered shell as a blunt weapon, although it was unclear whether Yidaro realized this.
